source.publisherTa: செய்தி விளம்பரத் துறை, தமிழ் நாடு அரசு
source.speechFactsNoteEn: The source booklet is an edited compilation of replies in both Houses; it establishes no single speech date.

semantics.note: The source booklet explicitly compiles replies delivered in both Houses and is preserved as one edited two-House witness. Page relation: scan 5 through 60: printed page = scan page - 1; scan 4 is an unnumbered opening mapped as implied printed page 3. The Tamil keeps the booklet's printed line breaks exactly as the verified transcription records them, including words divided at a line end. Underlying sittings: 1971-06-29 (Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly); 1971-06-30 (Tamil Nadu Legislative Council).

notes: The controlling source is the scanned printed booklet; it is not vendored. Its identity travels as filename, SHA-256 and page map.
